subject: sol-8/fix-1-native-lifecycle-next-chain.patch
head: bb7277d82 (includes 60051c3c2)
verdict_detail: Minor hold: admit after amendment B (native-specific false positive S4/S5); amendment A recommended in same change; C is a follow-up in class_hierarchy.rs.

checks.xtask_owner_resolution: clean (no counted-name delimiter/zero recipes in original_declaration.rs)
checks.check_name_resolution_proofs: pre-existing STALE evidence digests at HEAD for both files (references.rs e5fc3101 vs fa9062c4; original_declaration.rs 2fb2df2a vs c0cc0ebe); must be refreshed before PR gate; not introduced by this patch
checks.clippy_pedantic_expected: no new warnings (.filter().last() over opaque impl Iterator; pub(crate)/private fns)

findings.summary: Duplicate class records with the same rendered name (destroy+recreate, failed re-create) each get a Special identity; the provider walk is keyed by qualified_name so every record reports the same next site; only the live one is real (probe p5: new-Base). Breaks references<->definition symmetry; lexical path avoided it via all_classes body-span selection (references.rs:1257-1271).
ClassObject-side Special rows (invalid in TclOO: probe p1) are routed through the side-blind instance provider.

nextto X where X has no own effective ctor/dtor falls through to the next provider; real Tcl errors 'has no non-filter implementation by X' (probe p2 a,b,g,g2). Shared with lexical refs and native definition.
nextto a class that precedes the current class (e.g. its own mixin) returns that class; real Tcl errors 'not reachable from here' (probe p3 nexttomix, p2 self).
Empty destructor body deletes the destructor on 8.6.18 and 9.0.4 (probe p1); destructor_next_provider treats existence as provider, so subclass next is attributed to a deleted keyword.

NOTES inaccuracy: original_call_hierarchy::references is unaffected (Special arm adds nothing, original_call_hierarchy.rs:818-820). Affected consumers: references.rs:1016-1035, references.rs:4616-4629, code_lens.rs:119-138, tcl-lsp-server/src/readonly_reference_reports.rs:1673-1705. No edit/rename consumers.

Contract-aligned record-based owner exists: class_hierarchy/original_metadata.rs:32-50 original_instance_metadata_order and analyser/types/original_member_context.rs:470-497 provider_start (enforces nextto reachability).
Tests via_nextto_explicit_target/via_braced_nextto_target query base_refs at (4,6) = 'superclass' word, not Base's constructor (line 5); that half is vacuous.
Native lens cost becomes O(lifecycle identities x classes) body scans; counts are same-document only under ExistingInventory coverage.

semantics_confirmed_ok: plain next with class and superclass mixins matches tcloo_linearise mixin-first order (probe p3)
filters do not apply to constructors/destructors (probe p3)
no class-side constructor/destructor in TclOO 8.6.18/9.0.4 (probe p1)
last constructor wins; empty constructor body deletes and is already honoured by constructor_next_provider
diamond: reported provider is true for direct instantiation; misses are acceptable (positive-only)

amendments.B_required: Return empty unless special.side()==MemberSide::Instance and hierarchy.classes[class_q] via class_hierarchy::class_member_def(cd,&member) has name_span == special.keyword_word().span() (mirrors definition.rs:1318-1319; needs MemberSide import). Optionally join each other row by body span too.
amendments.A_recommended: In the Some(target) arm skip unless target == class_q and target's position in hierarchy.mro_map[other_q] is after other_q's.
amendments.C_followup: class_hierarchy.rs: apply is_empty_method_body to destructors; make nextto exact and reachable in constructor/destructor_next_provider (no hierarchy test pins the fall-through).
